lines: Mitsuki and the others had defeated the butler, Shigemori, and charged into the Lady's chamber.
As one might expect from her using the title of Lady, it was an opulent bedroom.
There was a canopy bed, a sofa and table for guests, and a fireplace on the wall.
Amid the darkness, paper lanterns in red, blue, yellow and so forth created an alluring air.
And then, Mitsuki unthinkingly let her voice out due to the most bizarre sight of all.
Mitsuki
「Ah, please look!」
More than ten giant balls of thread were hanging and swaying from the ceiling.
Bundles which looked like silkworm cocoons, about one metre in length and fifty centimetres across, made by spinning fine, white thread around and around.
There was no doubt that the people who had been held captive by the Lady of the Spiders were in there, still alive.
Rin
「Sanada must be in one of those. We'll have to open them one by one to check.」
Mutsuho
「Hanging her up to remove the bitter taste, right? At least she'll be docile.」
Mitsuki
「We'll definitely rescue her. The other people too, if possible.」
Rin
「I'd like to, but...」
Mutsuho
「Doesn't look like she's gonna make it easy for us, huh?」
Mitsuki had readied her fan, Rin her electric katana, and Mutsuho her poison needles.
All three of them were prepared for battle.
As if to mock that, the Lady of the Spiders, who had been sleeping in the bed at the back, got up languidly.
Lady of the Spiders
「What's all the noise?」
Even though she noticed Mitsuki and the rest, she was still making a sleepy-looking face.
Lady of the Spiders
「Damned Shigemori. You've been beaten, have you? Even he was more useless than I thought.」
Mitsuki
「Yeah, we defeated that person.」
Lady of the Spiders
「Not bad.」
Her demeanour suggested that she didn't even particularly mind that her faithful butler had been defeated.
Lady of the Spiders
「But, for you to go so far as to set foot in my chamber... I shall have to exterminate you insolent flies.」
That alone seemed to be what displeased her.
The Lady of the Spiders ground her eight legs in irritation.
Mitsuki
「You're the one who's going to be exterminated! Please prepare yourself!」
Mitsuki bluntly declared.
Lady of the Spiders
「Kukuku, you are going to exterminate me?」
After laughing flippantly, the Lady's eyes, which were cold as ice, lit up.
Lady of the Spiders
「You fools!」
